lines.en: label halloweenfour6:
scene toukamaskwkirin1
: Well, well, well. What do we have here? A vulnerable, yet lecherous teacher out in the wild and {i}not{/i} being bombarded by an onslaught of hormonal teenage girls?
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀。这是何方神圣？一个脆弱又好色的老师，就这么在野外晃荡，而且{i}没有{/i}被一群荷尔蒙过剩的少女围攻？

lines.en: : Why would you ask if you already know?
lines.zh: : 你既然已经知道了，干嘛还要问？

lines.en: : Because I’m worried about you, of course. Something appears to be wrong, but I also know that means you’re not going to be talking about it any time soon.
lines.zh: : 因为我担心你啊，当然。看起来确实有什么不对劲，但我也知道，这就意味着你短期内是不会开口谈的。

lines.en: : Observant as ever, I see.
lines.zh: : 一如既往地敏锐，我看。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin2

: It’s in my blood, I suppose. I’m sure it goes without saying at this point, but I take after my mother in a multitude of ways. Our affinity for {i}watching{/i} is just one of many traits I’ve luckily inherited.
lines.zh: : 大概是遗传吧。我想这已经不用多说了，我在很多方面都随我母亲。而对{i}旁观{/i}的偏好，只是我有幸继承的诸多特质之一。

lines.en: : Or {i}trained{/i} in as I’m pretty sure she’s just groomed you into a mini-Tsubasa by now.
lines.zh: : 或者说是{i}训练{/i}出来的——毕竟我很确信，她早就把你调教成一个迷你 Tsubasa 了。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin1
: We still disagree when it comes to...{i}certain{/i} things. But that’s not something I’d like to get into at this very moment.
lines.zh: : 我们在……{i}某些{/i}事情上仍然有分歧。不过眼下我不想谈这个。

lines.en: : Tell me. What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 告诉我。怎么了？

lines.en: : Sensei, as someone who {i}very{/i} recently played the role of your mother in a rather strange contest, I can assure you that whatever it is you have to say will not fall into the hands of anyone else.
lines.zh: : Sensei，作为一个{i}不久前{/i}刚在一场相当奇怪的比赛里扮演过你母亲的人，我可以向你保证，你要说的任何话都不会落到别人手里。

lines.en: : Granted, I did {i}lose{/i} that contest. So whether or not you actually {i}want{/i} to divulge anything to me remains to be seen.
lines.zh: : 诚然，那场比赛我{i}输{/i}了。所以你到底{i}想不想{/i}向我倾诉，还有待观察。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin3
: But I suppose, if nothing else, I could sink my nails into your back again? They’re extra {i}sharp{/i} tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，实在不行的话，我可以再把指甲掐进你的背里？今晚它们格外{i}锋利{/i}。

lines.en: : Sure. So long as you don’t mind doing it with your legs wrapped around my waist at the same time.
lines.zh: : 好啊。只要你不介意同时把腿缠在我腰上就行。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin4
: I can’t tell what expression you’re making beneath that mask.
lines.zh: : 我看不出那张面具底下你是什么表情。

lines.en: : I’m aware. That’s why I elected to not say anything. I was interested in seeing if you had anything else to add before I decimated your hopes and dreams.
lines.zh: : 我知道。所以我才选择什么都不说。我想看看在你还有没有别的要补充的，然后再把你的希望和梦想碾个粉碎。

lines.en: : I think I made my intentions pretty clear just now. No further clarification is needed.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我刚才把意图表达得够清楚了。不需要再补充说明。

lines.en: : All you “made clear” is your determination to keep running, no matter what it {i}is{/i} you’re running from.
lines.zh: : 你「表达清楚」的只有一件事：无论你{i}究竟{/i}在逃避什么，你都决心一直逃下去。

lines.en: : Well, I suppose you did also make your attraction to me clear. But, let’s be honest, we both already knew that was there to begin with.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想你也确实表明了对我的兴趣。不过说实话，这一点我们俩早就心知肚明了。

lines.en: : You really are like a mom sometimes, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你有时候真的像个妈妈，Touka。

lines.en: : That’s a very strange thing to say just moments after asking to bed me. Though, I suppose I {i}have{/i} heard something in the past about the Oedipus complex being closer to the truth than one would expect.
lines.zh: : 这话在刚提出要跟我上床之后说出来，可真够奇怪的。不过，我{i}确实{/i}听说过，俄狄浦斯情结比人们以为的更接近真相。

lines.en: : Am I to act as your shoulder or not, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我到底要不要当你的依靠，Sensei？

lines.en: : Give me a role to play and I will play it. Because Lord knows it beats standing off to the side and watching you roam around the room like some sort of malfunctioning robot.
lines.zh: : 给我一个角色，我就会演好它。因为老天作证，这总好过站在旁边，看着你像台故障机器人一样在房间里游荡。

lines.en: : Do you want to...leave this place together?
lines.zh: : 你想不想……跟我一起离开这里？

lines.en: : Right now?
lines.zh: : 现在？

lines.en: : Yeah. Right now.
lines.zh: : 对。现在。

lines.en: : And go where?
lines.zh: : 去哪儿？

lines.en: : Anywhere. Your room. My house. That new apartment you got me.
lines.zh: : 哪儿都行。你的房间。我家。你给我弄的那套新公寓。

lines.en: : Am I truly the one you wish to leave here with?
lines.zh: : 你真的想和我一起离开这里吗？

lines.en: : In the sense that I’m in love with you or something? No.
lines.zh: : 你是说我爱上你之类的？不是。

lines.en: : But in the sense that I feel eerily safe whenever I’m with you, yes. I want you by my side until this all boils over.
lines.zh: : 但如果说只要和你在一起我就有种诡异的安全感，是的。我想让你留在我身边，直到这一切彻底爆发。

lines.en: : And if it never does, will we remain together forever?
lines.zh: : 要是永远不爆发呢，我们就会永远在一起吗？

lines.en: : If it’s not too much trouble.
lines.zh: : 如果不算太麻烦的话。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin5
: That {i}does{/i} sound rather troublesome, if I’m being honest. I do believe I’d run out of buttons for you to push within weeks. I’m not sure how much fun it would be for either one of us.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那{i}确实{/i}听起来挺麻烦的。我相信不出几周，能让你按的按钮就被我用光了。我不确定那样对咱们俩还有多少乐趣。

lines.en: : Do you want to leave or not? You wanted a role to play and I’m giving you one.
lines.zh: : 你到底走不走？你不是想要个角色演吗，我现在就给你一个。

lines.en: : If you want my honest answer, yes. I would like that.
lines.zh: : 如果你要我老实回答，是的。我愿意。

lines.en: : Then-
: But it’s not going to happen.
lines.zh: : 但这不可能发生。

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin6
: Because, unlike you, I’m capable of thinking several steps ahead and know that leaving here with you would do naught but distract you for an hour at the most. Perhaps even less.
lines.zh: : 因为和你不同，我能提前想好几步，我知道跟你离开这里，顶多也只能让你分心一个小时。也许还不到。

lines.en: : Then, can you do me a favor and utilize this amazing foresight of yours to figure out the {i}several steps{/i} I need to follow to start feeling like I’m supposed to be here?
lines.zh: : 那么，能不能麻烦你用用你那惊人的先见之明，帮我算出我需要走的{i}那几步{/i}——好让自己重新觉得我本该在这里？

lines.en: : Which {i}here{/i} are you referring to, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你指的是哪个{i}这里{/i}，Sensei？

lines.en: : Is it the party?
lines.zh: : 是这场派对吗？

lines.en: : Or is it something else?
lines.zh: : 还是别的什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。

lines.en: : You poor thing.
lines.zh: : 你真可怜。

lines.en: : Your pity isn’t going to help, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你的同情帮不上忙，Touka。

lines.en: : It’s not pity.
lines.zh: : 那不是同情。

lines.en: : We’ve not known one another for long. But, in the time we {i}have{/i} spent together, I have witnessed several low points of yours. Nothing like {i}this,{/i} though. You look...
lines.zh: : 我们认识的时间不长。但在我们{i}共度{/i}的那段时光里，我目睹过你好几次低谷。不过都不像{i}现在这样{/i}。你看起来……

lines.en: : Well, for lack of better phrasing, you look like {i}Yasu.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，找不到更好的说法了，你看起来就像{i}Yasu{/i}。

lines.en: : Okay, now that’s just rude.
lines.zh: : 好，这就有点过分了。

lines.en: : I mean it, Sensei. You may not be...staring at the walls or...ranting about religious idols or anything of the sort, but there’s a hint of emptiness and longing in your eyes that...
lines.zh: : 我是认真的，Sensei。你也许没有……盯着墙发呆，或者……大谈宗教偶像之类的，但你眼神里有一丝空洞和渴望，那……

lines.en: : That makes {i}me{/i} feel lonely.
lines.zh: : 那让{i}我{/i}感到孤独。

lines.en: : I can’t leave this place with you...as I know that {i}I{/i} am not the one who can fill that void. That responsibility will fall on someone else in due time.
lines.zh: : 我不能跟你离开这里……因为我知道{i}我{/i}不是能填补那片空虚的人。这份责任到时候会落到别人身上。

lines.en: : But I’ll remain by your side until they appear if that is what you want instead.
lines.zh: : 但如果你想要的是另一个选项，我会留在你身边，直到那个人出现。

lines.en: : I can’t make you do that, Touka. I’m not the only one you’re responsible for babysitting after all.
lines.zh: : 我不能让你那么做，Touka。毕竟你要照顾的人又不只我一个。

lines.en: : Plus, I have Ami to watch over me if it really comes down to it.
lines.zh: : 再说，真到了那一步，还有 Ami 照顾我。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin7
: Then I suppose I’ll just have to accept you choosing her over me a second time. You’re more of an...Aphrodite than an Oedipus it seems.
lines.zh: : 那么看来，我只得接受你又一次选了她而不是我。看来你与其说是俄狄浦斯，不如说是……阿佛洛狄忒。

lines.en: : As someone who is formerly well-read but hasn’t touched a book or looked into anything involving Greek mythology in many years, I’m just going to assume I should be a little offended here and leave it at that.
lines.zh: : 作为一个曾经博览群书、但已经很多年没碰过书、也没了解过任何希腊神话的人，我就姑且认为这里我该有点被冒犯，然后就此打住吧。

lines.en: : That seems like a reasonable decision to me. But it calls into question — what are we to discuss now that we’re beginning to drift away from the ever-growing list of {i}mysteries{/i} that ail you?
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个决定挺合理的。不过这就引出一个问题——既然我们开始偏离那份越来越长、折磨着你的{i}谜团{/i}清单，那我们要聊什么？

lines.en: : We don’t have to talk at all. Let’s just hold hands and gaze into each other’s eyes. I’m sure that won’t set off any alarms in here.
lines.zh: : 我们根本不用说话。就牵着手，凝视彼此的眼睛好了。我敢肯定这不会触发这里的任何警报。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin8
: Hahah...as if. I’m sure the sprinklers would go off within seconds if such a thing were to happen.
lines.zh: : 哈哈……想得美。要是真发生这种事，我敢肯定喷淋系统几秒钟内就会启动。

lines.en: : Yeah. I wouldn’t be surprised if Ayane had her butler watching my every move via security camera as we speak.
lines.zh: : 是啊。要是 Ayane 这会儿正让管家通过监控摄像头盯着我的一举一动，我也不会意外。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin9
: Us wealthy people {i}do{/i} love our security cameras. That doesn’t seem all that unreasonable to me.
lines.zh: : 我们这些有钱人{i}确实{/i}喜欢监控摄像头。我觉得这没什么不合理的。

lines.en: : That’s not really something I’m comfortable hearing from my landlady.
lines.zh: : 这话从我房东嘴里说出来，我听着可不太舒服。

lines.en: : Your {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你的{i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin10
: Oh dear. This is going to be problematic, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。这下要麻烦了，是不是？

lines.en: : Yeah. I find that most things with Kirin are.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我发现跟 Kirin 有关的事大多如此。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin11
: Oh, come on. I’m not {i}that{/i} bad. I just like keeping things a little exciting.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。我没{i}那么{/i}坏。我只是喜欢让事情保持一点刺激感。

lines.en: : Now, what were you two talking about just now? Something about Touka being your {i}landlady?{/i} Is that slang for something? Has Sensei finally conquered the queen of Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 那么，你们俩刚才在聊什么？说什么 Touka 是你的{i}房东{/i}？那是某种黑话吗？Sensei 终于征服了 Kumon-mi 的女王？

lines.en: : “Conquered” meaning what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 「征服」具体是什么意思？

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin12
: Has his penis “entered” your “vagina?”
lines.zh: : 他的阴茎「进入」过你的「阴道」吗？

lines.en: : Kirin, come on.
lines.zh: : Kirin，别闹了。

lines.en: : Hey, I think that’s a reasonable question when it comes to you. Plus, you two have been over here chatting up a storm for like ten minutes now. {i}Something’s{/i} gotta be going on.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我觉得问你就算是合理的问题。再说，你们俩在这儿聊了得有十分钟了，聊得热火朝天。{i}肯定{/i}有什么事。

lines.en: : No, Kirin. I regret to inform you that I have not had sexual intercourse with the teacher. I sincerely apologize if that upsets you.
lines.zh: : 不，Kirin。我很遗憾地通知你，我并没有和老师发生过性关系。如果这让你失望，我深表歉意。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin13
: Don’t apologize to her. She’s just trying to start problems.
lines.zh: : 别跟她道歉。她就是想挑事。

lines.en: : It doesn’t {i}upset{/i} me. It {i}is{/i} a boring answer, though.
lines.zh: : 我才没有{i}失望{/i}。不过这答案{i}确实{/i}挺无聊的。

lines.en: : And {i}no,{/i} I’m not trying to start problems. Noriko’s just with Uta right now and I didn’t know who else to talk to.
lines.zh: : 还有，{i}不，{/i}我不是想挑事。Noriko 现在跟 Uta 在一起，我不知道还能找谁说话。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin14
: Does that also explain why you’ve taken it upon yourself to constrict his arm like a boa?
lines.zh: : 那是不是也解释了，你为什么自作主张像蟒蛇一样缠住他的胳膊？

lines.en: : No. {i}That{/i} I’m doing because I want him to put his penis inside of {i}my{/i} vagina.
lines.zh: : 不是。{i}那个{/i}是因为我想让他把阴茎放进{i}我的{/i}阴道里。

lines.en: : You really need to stop saying things like that to your classmates, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你真的别再对你的同学说这种话了，Kirin。

lines.en: : Maybe under normal circumstances. But I think I’ve just uncovered some hot gossip between you two and can now say a whole {i}bunch{/i} of stuff since I can use this new info as a bargaining chip.
lines.zh: : 平时也许吧。不过我觉得我刚挖到了你们俩之间的劲爆八卦，现在可以{i}放开了{/i}说一堆话，因为我能拿这个新情报当谈判筹码。

lines.en: : Weren’t you trying to be, like...a better person or something?
lines.zh: : 你不是正在努力当个……更好的人什么的吗？

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin15
: Mhm! But it’s not like I’m going to just turn into an angel overnight. My love for mischief is what makes me {i}me{/i} after all.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！可我也不会一夜之间就变成天使啊。对恶作剧的热爱才造就了{i}我{/i}这个人。

lines.en: : So, go on. What’s this landlady stuff about? Did the Tsukiokas buy out your neighborhood or something? Are they making a new mall there? What’s the deal?
lines.zh: : 所以，说吧。房东这事儿是怎么回事？Tsukioka 家把你那片街区买下来了吗？他们要在那儿建新商场？到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : The deal is that you should mind your own business and forget you heard anything.
lines.zh: : 怎么回事就是：你少管闲事，把听到的都忘掉。

lines.en: : And let my bargaining chip expire? Nuh-uh. I need {i}something{/i} to keep my lips sealed, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 然后让我的谈判筹码过期？才不要。我得拿到点{i}什么{/i}，才能把嘴闭上，Sensei。

lines.en: : You don’t even know what you’re keeping them sealed {i}about.{/i} Just that, in some regard, I am in charge of a property that Sensei inhabits. Which could mean essentially anything.
lines.zh: : 你连要{i}对什么{/i}保密都不知道。只知道从某种意义上说，我掌管着 Sensei 住的一处房产。而这可能意味着几乎任何事。

lines.en: : Does {i}Ami{/i} know?
lines.zh: : {i}Ami{/i}知道吗？

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin16
: Heheheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}go on. Name your price. How much do you want?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}说吧。开个价。你想要多少？

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin17
: Golly gee! I get to pick?! Yay!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！我可以自己挑？！好耶！

lines.en: : Are you really going to do this? Can’t you just leave us alone?
lines.zh: : 你真要这么做？你就不能别缠着我们吗？

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin18
: Would it make you feel better if I chose something easy?
lines.zh: : 那我挑个简单的，你会不会好受点？

lines.en: : Like?
lines.zh: : 比如？

lines.en: : Liiiiiiiiiike...
: A kiss?
lines.zh: : 一个吻？

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin19
: Have at it. Though, I do hope the Amamiya family butler happens to be looking away when it happens.
lines.zh: : 请便。不过我真希望事情发生时，Amamiya 家的管家恰好把头转开了。

lines.en: : Fine. We’ll have to go somewhere private, though.
lines.zh: : 好。不过我们得找个没人的地方。

lines.en: : Hm?
: Oh. Not with me. I meant you and Touka.
lines.zh: : 哦。不是跟我。我是说你和 Touka。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin20
: Um...you do realize Touka is {i}me,{/i} correct? I am her. That is my name.
lines.zh: : 呃……你知道 Touka 就是{i}我{/i}吧？我就是她。那是我的名字。

lines.en: : Mhm!
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！

lines.en: : And...And {i}why{/i} do you want us to kiss, exactly? What do you get out of this?
lines.zh: : 还有……你到底{i}为什么{/i}想让我们接吻？你能从中得到什么？

lines.en: : I just think it would be cute. Like a mother kissing her son. There doesn’t need to be tongue or anything. I won’t complain if there is, though. In fact, I say go for it.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得会很可爱。就像母亲亲吻儿子一样。不需要伸舌头什么的。不过要是伸了我也不会抱怨。事实上，我举双手赞成。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin21
: I’m waaaaaaiting...
: We’re in a room full of people right now.
lines.zh: : 我们现在可是在一屋子人中间。

lines.en: : Surely that isn’t the {i}only{/i} issue you have with this, is it?
lines.zh: : 这肯定不是你{i}唯一{/i}纠结的点吧？

lines.en: : It’s certainly the most damning and potentially destructive of them.
lines.zh: : 但这绝对是最要命、也最具破坏性的那一个。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin22
: I wouldn’t be so sure about that if I were you.
lines.zh: : 我要是你，可不会这么肯定。

lines.en: : Oh damn! She’s actually going for it. I just wanted to see her get all bashful and scurry off.
lines.zh: : 哦操！她居然来真的。我本来只想看她羞得满脸通红然后跑掉的。

lines.en: : I’ll say to you the same thing I said to Kirin. If we’re really going to do this, we need to go somewhere private and-
lines.zh: : 我对你说跟对 Kirin 说的一样的话。如果我们真要这么做，得找个没人的地方，而且-

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin23
: {i}Am I pretty?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我漂亮吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin24
: I’m tapping out.
lines.zh: : 我认输。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s fair. I’ve seen enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可以理解。我看够了。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin25
: Well, I hope you had your fun ruining an important conversation in the name of unwanted, mischievous antics.
lines.zh: : 那么，希望你玩得开心——以那些没人想要的恶作剧为名，毁掉了一场重要的对话。

lines.en: : Hey, it’s not my fault I just happened to overhear what I assumed was a pretty big deal. It’s not every day that you find out your teacher is paying rent to a student.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我碰巧听到了一件我猜是挺大的事，这又不是我的错。发现自己老师在向学生交房租，这种事可不是天天都有的。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin26
: He’s not paying me anything. He just has a second room at an apartment complex I purchased that I gifted to him on Christmas of last year.
lines.zh: : 他没有付我任何钱。他只是在我买下的一处公寓楼里有一间多余的房间，那是我去年圣诞节送给他的。

lines.en: : Wait, you’re letting him crash there for {i}free?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等，你让他{i}免费{/i}住在那儿？！

lines.en: : Can you not just tell that to people, please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别把这种事到处说？

lines.en: : She’s already caught on, Sensei. If anything, this saves {i}you{/i} the hassle of having her pester you about it until you ultimately break.
lines.zh: : 她已经察觉了，Sensei。要说有什么好处，这倒是替{i}你{/i}省了被她缠着问到你最终崩溃的麻烦。

lines.en: : You have enough going on to begin with and I don’t want to add more fuel to the fire when you’re already as...Yasu-ish as you’ve been tonight.
lines.zh: : 你本来就够多事了，而你今晚已经够……Yasu 了，我不想再火上浇油。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka-

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin27
: A question for you, Sensei. Would you still like me to remain by your side until you’re feeling better? Or would you rather try your chances with the {i}boa{/i} instead?
lines.zh: : 有个问题问你，Sensei。你还希望我留在你身边，直到你好起来吗？还是你更想在那条{i}蟒蛇{/i}身上碰碰运气？

lines.en: : Let me...{i}talk{/i} to Kirin for now and I’ll catch up with you again in a minute. Don’t go too far.
lines.zh: : 让我先……{i}跟{/i} Kirin 谈谈，我一会儿再去找你。别走太远。

lines.en: : I’ll go take a seat at my table. Please do try not to get bitten in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 我回我那桌坐下。这段时间内请务必别被咬到。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin28
Touka goes back to her seat and-
lines.zh: Touka 回到自己的座位，然后-

lines.en: : What the hell was that about?
lines.zh: : 那到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin29
And now I have to deal with this.
lines.zh: 现在我得应付这个了。

lines.en: : I think a better question is why you had to get yourself involved instead of just waiting for your turn.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更好的问题是，你为什么非要掺和进来，而不是乖乖等着轮到你。

lines.en: : I’ve been waiting for my turn ever since you got here. But more importantly than that, what the crap is going on with you and Touka?
lines.zh: : 从你来到这儿起，我就一直在等轮到我。不过更重要的是，你和 Touka 到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : “Don’t go too far?” {i}Remaining by your side?{/i} You really {i}are{/i} fucking her, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 「别走太远？」{i}留在你身边？{/i}你真的{i}在{/i}干她，对吧？

lines.en: : I’ve never done anything with her. I’ve just...felt like shit since I woke up. And the way she treats me makes me feel a little better sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我跟她什么都没做过。我只是……从醒来之后就一直很难受。而她对我的方式，有时候会让我好受一点。

lines.en: : You know, I said that “mother kissing her son” thing as a joke, but now it’s starting to sound like I wasn’t too far off.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我那句「母亲亲吻儿子」本来是当玩笑说的，现在听起来倒像是没差太远。

lines.en: : Also, what’s wrong? Is there anything {i}I{/i} can do to make you feel better? It doesn’t {i}have{/i} to be Touka, does it?
lines.zh: : 还有，到底怎么了？{i}我{/i}能做点什么让你好受些吗？非得是 Touka 不可吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s anything you can do, Kirin. And I’m not sure there’s anything Touka could have done either.
lines.zh: : 我想你什么也做不了，Kirin。我也不确定 Touka 能做什么。

lines.en: : I think this is something I’ve just got to...wait out.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这事我只能……熬过去。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin30
: Want to dance again? I can play Despacito on my phone. That {i}is{/i} our song and all.
lines.zh: : 要不要再跳一次舞？我可以用手机放 Despacito。那{i}可是{/i}我们的歌呢。

lines.en: : I really hate how that is the song we wound up “dancing” to, but no. I’m fine just...hanging out over here and only associating with the people who come to {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我真的很讨厌我们最后「跳舞」用的居然是那首歌，不过算了。我就……待在这儿，只跟主动来找{i}我{/i}的人打交道就好。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin31
: Would you mind at least delivering that memo to Noriko? Because she’s {i}also{/i} been “waiting for her turn” all night and you’ve yet to even look at her.
lines.zh: : 那你至少能把这句话转达给 Noriko 吗？因为她{i}也{/i}整晚都在「等着轮到自己」，而你连看都没看她一眼。

lines.en: : I’m looking at her right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在就在看她。

lines.en: scene toukamaskwkirin32
: And?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : Are you just going to let her wait?
lines.zh: : 你就打算让她这么等着？

lines.en: : Sensei, she’s not going to come up to you tonight. She wants {i}you{/i} to make the first move for once since she’s, and I quote, “Always bothering you at things like this.”
lines.zh: : Sensei，她今晚不会主动来找你的。她想让{i}你{/i}这次先迈出第一步，因为她，引用原话，「在这种场合总是缠着你」。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’d say she “bothers me,” but...
lines.zh: : 我不知道该不该说她「缠着我」，不过……

lines.en: : But what?...
lines.zh: : 不过什么？……

lines.en: scene black
: She looks too much like someone else I want to see right now.
lines.zh: : 她长得太像我现在想见的另一个人了。

lines.en: : And it makes everything worse.
lines.zh: : 而这让一切变得更糟。
